children: rose 2.8% in Friday's trading after scoring upgrades from analysts at Jefferies and Stephens following the stock's 15% post-
plunge in the previous session that showed FQ4 net income and operating margin declining Y/Y to $47.9M and 6.7%, respectively.
Jefferies analyst Stephen Volkmann upgraded MSC
to Buy from Hold with a $135 price target, edged up from $130, citing improving fundamentals and expected acceleration in volume growth momentum in 2027 alongside continued productivity improvement.

profit margins should continue to expand at 20%-30% incrementals given low variable costs, with headcount productivity providing a path toward mid-teens EBIT margins compared to ~10% currently, Volkmann wrote.
Stephens analyst Tommy Moll noted the shares now sit below his previous $113 bear-case scenario, prompting him to upgrade to Overweight from Equal Weight, also with a $135 PT.

had climbed 55% YTD leading into the earnings report, but Moll said elevated buyside expectations and a down day in the broader market prompted the stock's 15% slide, but future potential positive catalysts include inflation-driven margin tailwinds and a manufacturing volume-based recovery, whether driven by the end market or the company's internal initiatives.

title: MSC Industrial wins two brokerage upgrades after post-earnings plunge
